title: String Formatting and Localization knowledge check

questions.prompt: What is the most direct learning goal for this lesson?
options: Use string formatting and localization only for visual styling.
Skip type checking and accept any result.
Replace a focused example with unrelated code.

questions.answer_key: The main goal is to apply formatting numbers and dates in a small Swift example and verify the result.
